name: filum
description: Filum workspace scripts (Rust engine + React UI + Tauri shells)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix ui install && npm run wasm
scripts.build:web: npm run wasm && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --exclude filum-desktop && npm --prefix ui run typecheck && npm --prefix ui run test:match && node scripts/check-wording.mjs && node ui/scripts/check-design.mjs
